findings.trigger_condition: JWT_SECRET env var not set in production
findings.consequence: All auth tokens are forgeable using the public fallback secret
findings.recommendation: Fail at startup if JWT_SECRET is not set. Remove the fallback string entirely.
findings.exploit_poc: Sign any JWT with secret 'dev-secret-change-in-production', set role: 'ADMIN', userId: any — accepted as valid.

findings.file: apps/api-node/src/routes/bookings.ts, properties.ts, financials.ts, customers.ts, messages.ts, cleaning.ts, lawn.ts, dashboard.ts
findings.trigger_condition: Any HTTP request without Authorization header
findings.consequence: Full read/write access to all business data without credentials
findings.recommendation: Apply authMiddleware globally: app.use('/api', authMiddleware) with exemptions for /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register
findings.exploit_poc: curl http://host:4000/api/bookings — returns all bookings including guest PII with no auth header.

findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can escalate to ADMIN or modify any account
findings.recommendation: Add role check: if (req.user!.role !== 'ADMIN') return 403. Strip role field for non-admin callers.
findings.exploit_poc: Login as VIEWER, extract token, send PUT /api/auth/users/<any-id> with {"role":"ADMIN"} — succeeds.

findings.consequence: All stored API keys and platform credentials returned to unauthenticated caller
findings.recommendation: Add authMiddleware to GET /: router.get('/', authMiddleware, async ...)
findings.exploit_poc: curl http://host:4000/api/settings — returns all settings rows including any stored API keys.

findings.consequence: NaN stored as totalAmount — financial records silently corrupted
findings.recommendation: Add z.string().datetime() to booking schema for checkIn/checkOut. Add isNaN guard in service before arithmetic.

findings.trigger_condition: Two concurrent POST requests for same property overlapping dates
findings.consequence: Double-booking — two guests arrive same night
findings.recommendation: Add overlap check before prisma.booking.create with findFirst on [propertyId, dates, not-cancelled].
findings.exploit_poc: Two simultaneous POST /api/bookings with propertyId=X, checkIn=2026-07-04, checkOut=2026-07-07 — both succeed.

findings.trigger_condition: Dashboard loaded when >15 STR properties or when lawn/cleaning have expenses
findings.consequence: Expense values displayed as revenue for lawn/cleaning LLCs; hardcoded unit cap breaks display
findings.recommendation: Set mtdRevenue:0 for unimplemented revenue tracking. Replace hardcoded 15 with dynamic property count or config.
findings.exploit_poc: Operational — any dashboard load with >15 STR properties shows invalid fraction; any lawn/cleaning expense shows as revenue.

findings.consequence: Account deletion without admin privilege; potential last-admin lockout
findings.recommendation: Restrict to ADMIN role. Add last-admin guard before delete.
findings.exploit_poc: Login as VIEWER, send DELETE /api/auth/users/<admin-id> — admin account deleted.

findings.trigger_condition: User password reset or account deletion
findings.consequence: Attacker token valid 7 days post-compromise; deleted accounts authenticate for up to 7 days
findings.recommendation: Reduce JWT_EXPIRES_IN to 1h + add refresh token. Add tokenVersion counter incremented on password change.
findings.exploit_poc: Steal token, user changes password — token still valid for up to 7 days.

findings.consequence: Update silently ignored — confusion about why field did not update
findings.recommendation: Use if (data.guestName !== undefined) consistently with other fields.

findings.trigger_condition: Booking spans month boundary (e.g. Dec 31 – Jan 5)
findings.consequence: Revenue attributed to wrong month — P&L figures diverge from actual nightly revenue
findings.recommendation: Use checkOut date or per-night attribution for monthly revenue calculation.

findings.trigger_condition: Frontend deployed to any non-localhost origin
findings.consequence: CORS blocks all API requests from production frontend
findings.recommendation: Drive origin list from ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var.

Fix HG-005: datetime validation on booking dates
